title: Cosmic Black Hole Vision
description: A surreal cosmic scene centered on a glowing black hole with a bright blue and purple accretion disk. The composition includes geometric patterns, floating musical notes, a small skeleton figure standing on a purple crystalline landscape, a red ringed planet, and stylized mountain peaks above the central vortex against a dark background.
